items.name: MvPolynomial.restrictSupport
items.type: {σ : Type u} (R : Type v) [CommSemiring R] (s : Set (σ →₀ ℕ)) : Submodule R (MvPolynomial σ R)

items.name: MvPolynomial.restrictSupport_univ
items.type: {σ : Type u} (R : Type v) [CommSemiring R] : MvPolynomial.restrictSupport R Set.univ = ⊤

items.name: MvPolynomial.mem_restrictSupport_iff
items.type: {σ : Type u} (R : Type v) [CommSemiring R] {s : Set (σ →₀ ℕ)} {r : MvPolynomial σ R} : r ∈ MvPolynomial.restrictSupport R s ↔ ↑r.support ⊆ s

items.name: MvPolynomial.restrictSupport_zero
items.type: {σ : Type u} (R : Type v) [CommSemiring R] : MvPolynomial.restrictSupport R 0 = 1

items.name: MvPolynomial.restrictSupport_mono
items.type: {σ : Type u} (R : Type v) [CommSemiring R] {s t : Set (σ →₀ ℕ)} (h : s ⊆ t) : MvPolynomial.restrictSupport R s ≤ MvPolynomial.restrictSupport R t

items.name: MvPolynomial.basisRestrictSupport
items.type: {σ : Type u} (R : Type v) [CommSemiring R] (s : Set (σ →₀ ℕ)) : Module.Basis (↑s) R ↥(MvPolynomial.restrictSupport R s)

items.name: MvPolynomial.restrictScalars_restrictSupportIdeal
items.type: {σ : Type u} (R : Type v) [CommSemiring R] (s : Set (σ →₀ ℕ)) (hs : IsUpperSet s) : Submodule.restrictScalars R (MvPolynomial.restrictSupportIdeal R s hs) = MvPolynomial.restrictSupport R s

items.name: MvPolynomial.restrictSupport_eq_span
items.type: {σ : Type u} (R : Type v) [CommSemiring R] (s : Set (σ →₀ ℕ)) : MvPolynomial.restrictSupport R s = Submodule.span R ((fun x => (MvPolynomial.monomial x) 1) '' s)
